title: Buried Signal
summary: An innocent-looking PNG has another file hidden inside it. Carve it out.
briefing:
An analyst pulled an image (evidence.png) off a suspect's USB drive. It renders as a tiny, unremarkable picture — but the file on disk is much larger than a 1x1 image should be. Something is appended after the end of the PNG data.

Use file-carving tools to find and extract the hidden content:

  file evidence.png          # identify
  binwalk evidence.png       # shows embedded file signatures
  binwalk -e evidence.png    # auto-extract
  foremost evidence.png      # alternative carver
  unzip evidence.png         # the appended data is a ZIP archive

Extract the hidden archive, read the file inside it, and submit the flag.
objectives: Notice the PNG is larger than its image dimensions justify
Run binwalk to find the appended file signature
Read the file inside and submit the flag

hints.title: Look past IEND
hints.text: A PNG ends at its IEND chunk. Anything after that is extra. binwalk evidence.png will show a "Zip archive data" entry after the PNG image.

hints.title: Extract it
hints.text: The appended data is a valid ZIP. You can run unzip directly on the PNG: unzip evidence.png (ignore the "extra bytes" warning). It contains flag.txt.

artifacts.description: PNG image carved from a USB drive — larger than it looks.
